anyprofile.metaTitle: AnyProfile — free multi-profile browser for macOS & Windows
anyprofile.metaDescription: Free, open-source app that gives every account its own browser: separate cookies, its own proxy and a consistent fingerprint. For macOS and Windows.
anyprofile.title: AnyProfile
anyprofile.tagline: One browser per account, side by side.
anyprofile.intro: AnyProfile is a free desktop app for creators and sellers who run several TikTok, YouTube, Shopee or Amazon accounts. Each profile is a separate browser with its own cookies, its own proxy and a consistent device fingerprint, so sessions never mix.
anyprofile.howToInstall: How to install and open it the first time

features.title: Separate profiles
features.body: Every profile keeps its own logins, cookies, history and extensions. Open as many as you like at once.

features.title: A proxy per profile
features.body: Timezone and languages follow the proxy’s exit IP. The app warns when the IP changes country or timezone, or when its IPv6 exit is somewhere else.

features.title: A consistent fingerprint
features.body: Each profile looks like the same real computer every time it opens, built on the operating system you actually run.

features.title: Start pages by country
features.body: Pick the platforms a profile works on; seller centers of TikTok Shop, Shopee, Lazada and Amazon open for the proxy’s country.

features.title: Accounts and 2FA
features.body: Keep each platform’s login, password and 2FA secret with the profile, stored in the system keychain; copy codes with one click.

features.title: Updates and automation
features.body: Signed in-app updates, snapshots of a profile, bookmark import and a local API for Puppeteer, Playwright or n8n.

steps: Open the downloaded AnyProfile-macos-arm64.dmg and drag AnyProfile onto Applications.

Open AnyProfile. The first time, macOS says “Apple could not verify…”: choose Done (not Move to Trash), then open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll to Security, choose Open Anyway and enter your password. You do this once.
When macOS asks whether AnyProfile may use the Keychain, choose Always Allow.
Run AnyProfile-amd64-installer.exe. No administrator rights are needed.
If Windows shows “Windows protected your PC”, choose More info → Run anyway.
On first start, AnyProfile downloads its browser engine (about 180 MB).

requirements: The builds are not yet signed by Apple or Microsoft, hence the warnings above.
A profile opens only on the operating system that created it.
Bring your own proxies; residential proxies work best with social and shopping sites.
privacy: Everything stays on your computer: profiles, proxies and settings in the app’s folder, passwords in the macOS Keychain or Windows Credential Manager.
There is no account, no server, no analytics and no crash reporting. The app only checks GitHub once a day for a new version.
anyprofile.openSource: AnyProfile is free software under the GNU AGPL v3. Read the code, report a bug or follow development on GitHub.
anyprofile.responsibility: You are responsible for following the rules of every platform you use. Many limit how many accounts one person may run; AnyProfile does not change those rules.

landing.metaTitle: AnyTools: study your documents with AI + free online tools
landing.metaDescription: Upload your notes or PDFs and AnyLearn writes quizzes, answers with the page cited and plans spaced repetition on your own AI. Plus 130 free browser tools.
landing.title: Study from your own documents.
landing.subtitle: Check every answer against the page it came from.
landing.lede: Answers that cite the page, quizzes written from your material, and reviews timed to just before you forget.
landing.ctaNote: Free. Google or GitHub sign-in; no password.

read.title: Read
read.body: Your documents, notebooks and living books.

ask.title: Ask
ask.body: Answers with citations, worked solutions and research reports.

practise.title: Practise
practise.body: Quizzes, exams and spaced review, until a point stays.

reflect.title: Reflect
reflect.body: One goal, the evidence that it is moving, and worksheets.

landing.lead: AnyLearn is the study app in AnyTools, beside free tools that run in your browser with no account. Upload the material you are learning from, and AnyLearn answers questions about it with citations that open the exact page, writes quizzes from it, schedules what you are about to forget, and keeps a 90-day record of what you can actually do, all on the AI accounts you already pay for.

cite.title: Answers that point at the page
cite.body: Chat, quizzes and research cite the passage they used. A citation opens your document at that page, so a claim can be checked instead of trusted.

practice.title: Practice that schedules itself
practice.body: Questions are written from your material and marked with an explanation. A mastery path brings back what you got wrong the same day, and what you know just before you would forget it.

evidence.title: Progress backed by evidence
evidence.body: A 90-day learning loop moves forward only when quiz results, reviews and notes show it should, not when a box is ticked.

byok.title: Your own AI accounts
byok.body: Connect a key from Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral or another supported provider. There are no platform keys and no credits: nothing runs until one of yours is connected, and you choose which account does which job.

landing.notBody: AnyLearn does not answer from its own general knowledge when your documents are silent; it says they do not cover the question. It does not keep streaks, points or badges. And it cannot promise that a file never reaches an AI provider: reading a document means sending it to the model you chose, and every document shows which one read it.

tools.title: Appendix: free tools, no account
tools.body: More than a hundred everyday tools: formatters, encoders, converters, calculators, and PDF and image tools. They run in your browser, need no sign-in, and come in English, Vietnamese, Spanish and Portuguese.

postclaw.title: Also from us: PostClaw
postclaw.tagline: An AI agent that writes, schedules and publishes your social posts.
postclaw.body: PostClaw is a hosted social media scheduler, with nothing to install. Its agent drafts your posts, lays them out on a calendar and publishes them to 18 platforms, 11 social networks and 7 blogs, from one place. It makes images and video too, and works with your own AI key.

landing.footer: AnyLearn is in early access. Your documents and connected accounts stay yours; you can remove any of them at any time.
